_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - copy this file to RUNTIME config and edit it there.
The real file is RUNTIME STATE. It is never committed to this repository,
because it contains machine-specific absolute paths and access policy.
Then chmod 600 and replace every <PLACEHOLDER> with a real value.

<workspace-alias>._doc: Optional. A development directory you trust. Git repositories inside it are auto-discovered as READ_ONLY projects with runScripts=false. Remove this block entirely to keep per-project registration only.

<project-name>._doc: Original repository. Keep write=false so the source of truth stays untouched.

<project-name>-writable._doc: Optional: a git worktree or scratch project that is allowed to accept writes.

_fieldReference.root: Absolute path to the project root. Must exist. Resolved with realpath before every operation.
_fieldReference.write: false = READ_ONLY (default). true = READ_WRITE, still subject to branch and sensitivity rules.
_fieldReference.runScripts: Whether sandboxed script execution is enabled for this project (v2.0.0+). When true, run_script may execute npm/pnpm scripts inside the macOS Seatbelt sandbox. Still subject to hash-pinning and obvious-deny. Default false.
_fieldReference.allowedScripts: Per-project allowlist of script NAMES permitted to run when runScripts is true (e.g. ["build","test"]). install/ci/add and obvious-deny scripts are rejected regardless of this list. Default empty.
_fieldReference.scriptHashes: Optional. Map of scriptName -> expected sha256 of the script body. When present, run_script verifies the script-content hash before execution (TOCTOU layer C; distinct from the caller-supplied expectedPackageSha256 which covers the whole package).
_fieldReference.packageManager: Optional. Pin the package manager for this project: "npm" or "pnpm". When omitted, auto-detected from lockfile; any other manager (yarn/bun/npx) is rejected.
_fieldReference.managedWorktree: Set automatically by git_worktree_create. Do not author this by hand.
_fieldReference.sourceProject: Set automatically by git_worktree_create. Do not author this by hand.
_fieldReference.branch: Set automatically by git_worktree_create. Do not author this by hand.
_fieldReference.protectedBranches: Optional extra branch names that must reject writes. Defaults already cover main and master.
_fieldReference.github.enabled: Optional boolean. When true, enables restricted GitHub repository management (github_repository_info, github_repository_create). Requires token in macOS Keychain service 'local-mcp-dev-runner-github-api-token'. Default false.
_fieldReference.github.allowedOrganizations: Array of GitHub organizations authorized for repository queries and creation. Requests for any organization outside this list FAIL-CLOSED.
_fieldReference.trustedWorkspaces: Object map of { alias: { root, maxDepth?, enabled? } }. Each alias declares ONE trusted development directory. Key = workspace alias (^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_-]{0,39}$).
_fieldReference.trustedWorkspaces.<alias>.root: Absolute path to the workspace root. Must exist and resolve with realpath. Broad roots (/, /Users, /System, /tmp, /private, ...) are rejected.
_fieldReference.trustedWorkspaces.<alias>.maxDepth: Optional scan depth, 1-5, default 3. Depth 3 reaches <root>/group/subgroup/repo.
_fieldReference.trustedWorkspaces.<alias>.enabled: Optional boolean, default true. false skips the workspace without removing its declaration.
_fieldReference.[discovery] permissions: Auto-discovered repositories are ALWAYS write=false and runScripts=false. No configuration field can raise them. To write, use git_worktree_create on the discovered project.
_fieldReference.[discovery] naming: A discovered repository is exposed by its directory name when that name is unambiguous, otherwise by its stable id '<alias>/<path/relative/to/workspace>'. Both forms resolve.
_fieldReference.[discovery] precedence: Explicit projects always win. A repository already registered under 'projects' is never also exposed as auto-discovered.
